hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/simpleterm-antigravity" "$HOME/.simpleterm/src/plugins/simpleterm" .; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" ] && exec sh "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" agy PreToolUse; done; exit 0'

Stop.command: sh -c 'for d in "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/simpleterm-antigravity" "$HOME/.simpleterm/src/plugins/simpleterm" .; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" ] && exec sh "$d/scripts/agent-hook.sh" agy Stop; done; exit 0'
